title: Critique of Cynical Reason (Kritik der zynischen Vernunft)

publication.edition: trans. Michael Eldred; German original: Kritik der zynischen Vernunft, Suhrkamp, 1983

Used for the modern-cynicism diagnosis the book is named for: knowing, avowed disbelief that changes nothing — enlightened false consciousness — as the modern inversion of the ancient Cynic's practiced commitment.
